claims: Detroit Tigers opened the 2026 MLB season with an 8-2 victory over the San Diego Padres
The opening game was on Thursday, March 26, 2026
The opening game was at Petco Park
Rookie Kevin McGonigle had four hits and three RBIs in his debut
Detroit Tigers started their season on the road for the fourth consecutive year
Final score of the game was Detroit Tigers 8, San Diego Padres 2
Tarik Skubal had 6 strikeouts and 1 unearned run in 6 innings
Rookie Kevin McGonigle went 4-for-5 with two doubles in his debut
Petco Park is in San Diego
The victory marked the 12th opening day win for the Detroit Tigers in their last 15 seasons
The game was part of the full MLB opening day
The full MLB opening day followed a special night game on March 25, 2026
Tigers games for the 2026 season are available on Detroit SportsNet (DSN)
